players.product: 3D / 2D automated visual inspection systems for semiconductor packages, memory modules / SSDs and flip-chip substrates (WSI bump inspection)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (consolidated): Q2 2026 revenue KRW 8,960,989,867 vs KRW 25,149,574,762 in Q2 2025, with an operating loss of KRW 5,117,444,745 vs an operating profit of KRW 1,575,596,707 a year earlier; H1 2026 revenue KRW 21,766,334,986 (H1 2025: KRW 39,556,693,747) and H1 operating loss KRW 7,025,010,330

H1 2026 mix: semiconductor visual inspection (package, SSD, memory module and flip-chip substrate inspection) KRW 16,217 million (74.5%), display and secondary-battery inspection KRW 5,549 million (25.5%); exports 59.7% of revenue. H1 revenue by region: Korea KRW 8,704,681 thousand, China KRW 4,120,265 thousand, Taiwan KRW 3,263,637 thousand, US KRW 2,515,577 thousand. Customers >10% of revenue (undisclosed): A KRW 4,789,505 thousand, B KRW 2,206,000 thousand, C KRW 2,713,825 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor inspection KRW 16,217 million (74.5%); display/battery KRW 5,549 million (25.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog at 06-30-2026 of KRW 126,169 million for 136 systems (orders 2024-2026, delivery 2025-2027), of which semiconductor visual inspection KRW 103,950 million (96 units) and display/battery inspection KRW 22,219 million (40 units); customer advances (contract liabilities) KRW 18,378,727 thousand vs KRW 13,731,192 thousand at end-2025, with inventory rising to KRW 43,681,800 thousand as systems are built
quarterly_data.figure: backlog KRW 126,169 million; semiconductor KRW 103,950 million

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor substrate inspection equipment supply contracts with takewin International Ltd: KRW 9,632,969,400 (filed 03-04-2026, term 03-03-2026 to 08-30-2027, KRW 2,343,447 thousand received) and KRW 7,157,709,900 (filed 06-26-2026, term 06-24-2026 to 05-15-2027); both in progress
Semiconductor and substrate inspection equipment supply contract with ALKAID TECH LTD (filed 06-26-2026, term 06-25-2026 to 03-01-2028), in progress

Plant production capacity, including outsourced plants, estimated at about KRW 2,000 hundred-million (KRW 200 billion) of annual output vs H1 2026 production of about KRW 217 hundred-million (KRW 21.7 billion); systems are built to order, so no utilisation rate is reported
quarterly_data.figure: capacity about KRW 200 billion; H1 production about KRW 21.7 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Company says rising server / AI / automotive advanced packages are lifting adoption of its high-end back-end inspection systems at global IDMs and OSATs (domestic large IDM and OSAT, a US global IDM, Taiwan and China OSATs); its WSI flip-chip substrate inspection solution completed performance validation at a US global semiconductor company and is supplied to major global substrate makers; it is expanding into wafer bump, warpage, fine RDL and WLP inspection. Government projects: DUV-based 2D/3D inspection for ultra-high-density hybrid bonding 3D stacks (07-01-2025 to 12-31-2028, KRW 6,402,000 thousand) and UV digital-holography inline inspection of micro-bumps and RDL interposers (07-01-2025 to 06-30-2030, KRW 8,000,000 thousand)
quarterly_data.figure: hybrid-bonding project KRW 6,402,000 thousand; interposer project KRW 8,000,000 thousand
